ModMetaData.name: CE Reloaded
ModMetaData.author: Butch
ModMetaData.description:
CE Reloaded takes the micromanagement out of Combat Extended.
CE is great, but every colonist needs the right gun, the right ammo and enough of it - and someone has to craft all of that. CE Reloaded handles it for you.
BETA I worked on this mod for months, then mod fatigue set in. It is ready to play, but you may hit rough edges. Please give it a try and tell me what works and what breaks - your feedback decides what gets fixed next. Back up your save, as with any mod.
LAZY? ONE BUTTON "Arm my Colony" in the Assign tab picks a weapon for every colonist based on their skills, sets up their ammo and gear, and queues crafting bills for whatever is missing.
WANT TO STAY IN CHARGE? FULL CONTROL, NONE OF THE TEDIUM The Loadout Planner shows every colonist as a card. Pick a weapon from a ranked list and the matching ammo comes with it. Preview the automatic assignment before anything changes.
ALSO INCLUDED - Fetch gear now: colonists collect their loadout right away instead of one item every 30 seconds - Readiness light: see at a glance who is missing a weapon or ammo - Equipment packs: reusable kits for medicine, food, drugs and shields - Sidearms, weapon locks, weapon scores, icons for special ammo - Ammo bills that follow what your colonists actually need - 13 languages
SAFE TO USE No new items and no balance changes. The mod only creates normal CE loadouts and bills, which you can still edit by hand. Works in existing saves. Before removing it, use "Prepare save for uninstall" in the mod settings.
Requires Harmony and Combat Extended (load after CE).
Source: github.com/Butch182/CE-Reloaded Support: ko-fi.com/butch182
